turns.text: I invited a player to join my High School Roster.  They now show up in my community but not on my roster.

Got it — the player appears in your community but hasn't shown up on the roster yet. Let me help you sort this out.

First, a quick clarification: are you a coach or admin managing the high school team page? And which high school are we talking about?

Once I have those details, I can walk you through the next steps or escalate this to our team if there's a sync issue on our end.
I am a coach and admin managing the high school page
Perfect. And which high school are you managing the roster for?
Western Reserve Academy Girls

Thanks. So to clarify the issue: the player you invited is showing up in your community, but when you look at your roster page for Western Reserve Academy Girls, they're not listed there yet — is that right?

A couple of quick things to check:

1. Refresh your roster page — sometimes there's a slight delay in the display updating after an invite is accepted.

2. Verify the player accepted the invite — they may still be pending. Check your community members list to see if their status shows "pending" or "accepted."

3. Make sure they're assigned to the correct team/grade level if your school has multiple rosters.

If you've checked those and the player still isn't showing on the roster after a refresh, I can escalate this to our team for a manual review. Can you let me know: has the player accepted the invite, and have you refreshed the page since they joined?
I can help you with duplicate player profiles! To get started, could you let me know which of the following applies to your situation?
My own duplicate profiles

Got it! I'll help you get your duplicate profiles merged.

To move forward, I'll need a few details:

1. **Your full name**
2. **Your preferred account email**
3. **Profile links or Player IDs** for both profiles (if you have them) — or just the display names if you don't have the URLs

Could you share those?

Ha Kim
[email]
https://app.utrsports.net/profiles/5857869
and 
https://app.utrsports.net/profiles/4578118

Thanks, Ha Kim! Just to confirm, which of these profiles would you like to keep as your **primary** profile?

- Profile 1: https://app.utrsports.net/profiles/5857869
- Profile 2: https://app.utrsports.net/profiles/4578118
Profile 2
Got it! Let me look up what to expect when reporting duplicate profiles, then I'll submit your request.

Here's what to expect after your request is submitted:

- **Manual review:** The support team reviews duplicate profile reports manually.
- **Processing time:** It may take several business days depending on volume.
- **Possible follow-up:** The team may request photo ID or additional details to verify the profiles.
- **Notification:** You'll be notified once the review is complete or if more info is needed.
- **In the meantime:** Please don't create any new accounts or make significant changes to your profiles while the request is under review.

Let me go ahead and submit your ticket now!

Your support ticket has been submitted — your ticket number is **#836081**. 🎾

Here's a summary of your request:
- **Name:** Ha Kim
- **Email:** [email]
- **Primary profile (to keep):** https://app.utrsports.net/profiles/4578118
- **Duplicate profile (to merge):** https://app.utrsports.net/profiles/5857869

The support team will review your request and may reach out if they need additional information. In the meantime, please avoid creating new accounts or making significant changes to either profile.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
Nope that is great. Can I please get a copy of this request via my email?

glad ticket is submitted! Unfortunately, not to send emails directly from here. However, you should automatically receive a confirmation email at **[email]** from our support system with your ticket details (ticket #836081).

If you don't see it, please check your spam/junk folder. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Need to speak with someone

here help! To get you to the right person or solution, could you tell me a bit more about what you need? For example: a missing score, an account or login issue, a duplicate profile, an event question, a subscription issue, or something else?
I got an rewards of $59 for fabletic but I can’t buy anything
Got it — you have a Fabletics VIP reward balance but can't use it to purchase. Let me pull up the right steps for that.
Let me search for troubleshooting steps on this.

The search didn't return specific troubleshooting for reward balance issues. This sounds like a Fabletics product or account issue — Fabletics Support handles all questions about using rewards, applying them to orders, and account-specific problems on their end.

Please reach out to Fabletics Support directly through their Help Center at https://help.fabletics.com/hc/en-us — they'll be able to see your reward balance and help you apply it to a purchase.

Is there anything else I can help with regarding your UTR Power membership or the Fabletics VIP benefit itself?
